method: Each of the 186 final CI PDF pages was opened directly at native size, at most two images per call. The exact Word has a separate canonical rendering and visual review covering 186 pages.

limitations: The delivered PDF has 186 pages; the canonical Word renderer produces 186. Each artifact is reviewed using its actual pagination.
Visual review verifies visible layout, completeness and the corrected catalogue references. It does not claim that the future campaign or AAA assets are implemented.
Source-word totals are whitespace counts from the Markdown sources, not an independent count of printed PDF words.
